iEEGReference: Scalp reference ('Data were recorded with respect to a scalp reference.', motor_basic README (SDR zk881ps0522))

Bandpass.Description: Built-in amplifier band pass 0.15 to 200 Hz, 1-pole, so no sharp corner at 200 Hz; amplitude roll-off function in ns_1k_1_300_filt.mat (motor_basic README (SDR zk881ps0522)).

TaskDescription: Cue-based hand and tongue movement: repetitive self-paced movements (~1-2 Hz) of hand (synchronous flexion/extension of all fingers) or tongue (opening of mouth with protrusion and retraction of the tongue), contralateral to the grid, in 2 s or 3 s cue blocks alternating with rest blocks of the same length (blank screen); 30-75 cues per modality; visual cues presented with BCI2000 as a written word in a 10 x 10 cm window at 75-100 cm. (motor_basic README; Miller et al. 2007 J Neurosci doi:10.1523/JNEUROSCI.3886-06.2007)
Instructions: Perform repetitive, self-paced movement of the cued body part during the cue, alternating with rest when the cue is absent (motor_basic README).
